finding.w57_observed_failure: Both W57 closeout-only evidence artifacts quoted an identity that is not the candidate: the canonical report header recorded the stale cf5aff2031aed28d70e3365e3db5a744b5f9f3781b35f13d5e558382acd217b0 (from dispatch 122) and the successor freeze declaration recorded 8f522decd2c83afd9ffb70dd7ad36e19b73c1617bca4278c47093aabcdfad839, which is W30's audit_receipt.tested_content_identity, not W57's own identity. Evidence binding in this program is fail-closed, so a foreign or superseded identity in an evidence header is a real reporting defect.
finding.why_it_looked_unfixable: The same rebind had been attempted under W57-SUCCESSOR-FREEZE-REBIND across 47 consecutive dispatches (0025-0091) and never appeared to stick, which reads as a self-invalidating oscillation.

hypothesis.claim: If the rebind were self-invalidating, the identity written into a W57 closeout-only artifact would itself be an input to the digest that artifact quotes, so the value would go stale on the next dispatch regardless of what was written.
hypothesis.prediction: HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED AS FALSE. The rebind is convergent.
hypothesis.mechanism: The W57 evidence identity is wave_state_engine.repository_content_identity() evaluated with the profile's allowed_closeout_only_paths as ignore prefixes, and that filter is applied inside the hashing loop at .opencode/scripts/wave_state_engine.py:1028-1030 ('if not rel or _is_under(rel, ignored): continue'). The profile's allowed_closeout_only_paths contains 'docs/wave-reports/' and 'artifacts/', which are exactly W57's two closeout-only surfaces. Neither is an input to the digest it quotes.
hypothesis.why_prior_repeats_went_stale: Other closure members moved, not the rebind. The identity closure holds 1058 tracked/untracked paths; the movers are the tracked lab/config.json, lab/lab-common.ps1, lab/lab-test.ps1 repair delta and six untracked root-level stray scripts (parallel_workspace.py, route-wave-findings.py, run-wave-program.py, wave_progress.py, wave_state_engine.py, test_wave_controller_regressions.py).
hypothesis.next_suspect_measured_and_falsified: lab/evidence/ and lab/state/ are git-ignored and are therefore NOT in the identity closure, so a lab run does not move the identity. This was measured rather than assumed, because it is the obvious next suspect.
